facts.raw_span: A 52-year-old man with HCV-associated end-stage cirrhosis
underwent liver transplantation
intra-abdominal bleeding from a choledochal artery branch
cholestasis was observed with worsening cytolysis
persistent abdominal pain
fulminant liver failure and hemodynamic shock
a single fever peak (38.4°C)
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST): 5.04 μkat/L
Alanine aminotransferase (ALT): 5.14 μkat/L
Blood culture (day 7): Positive
diffuse liver necrosis without vascular thrombosis or biliary leakage
the patient died on day 9 during laparotomy
